changes: Added episode-writing guidance to preserve location and scenery until an explicitly written change.
Direct dialogue and delivery from each character’s published personality and voice description.
Plan connected scene boundaries, complete dialogue and gestures, and consistent ambient sound; review continuity after reordering scenes.
Animate channel episodes with OpenAI video generation, using scene order and published character appearance, personality and voice.
Inspect queued, generating, assembling, ready and failed video versions, with persistent video storage and playback links.
Episodes now begin as drafts. Directors explicitly publish a completed stored video; viewers see only published episodes and their selected video.
The channel player supports episode navigation and team-only video history. The currently documented Sora API retires September 24, 2026.
Added the ettu-update skill and read-only check_ettu_update MCP tool to compare installed and available plugin versions, summarize release notes, and guide updates in Codex, Claude Code, and ChatGPT.
Bundled release.json so the installed version travels with both skills and the MCP configuration.
Added guidance for setting or clearing your public full name with update_my_profile.
Clarified that character followers can appear publicly on character pages; authentication IDs and raw follow lists remain private.
